title: legs27: H1 chop means no direction; H2 long leg then a longer counter-leg; issue 310
before_registration: Nothing computed on market data before this file (synthetic self-checks only). Prior knowledge: notrade12 (spread and thin hours), daytype14 (trend-day probability is context only), de_v2 ER feature.
declared: Development evidence only. 2023+ is a development window, not a holdout (inspected by earlier campaigns). Operator decision: judged GROSS (mid) with realistic latency (act at the next bar open after the condition is known); net (bid/ask) is secondary where it applies (H2 fade). Binding confirmation is prospective (issue 313) or post-2026-10-07 data.
data: engine/cache M1 bid/ask via nt12.load_m1c (cut 2026-10-07T18:30 UTC); M5/M15 by bars.resample; mid = (bid+ask)/2

H1.timeframes: M5 primary; M1 and M15 secondary (same rules in bars of that timeframe)
H1.measures: at each closed bar t with bars t-12..t contiguous: ER = |c_t - c_(t-12)| / sum_(i=t-11..t) |c_i - c_(i-1)| (mid closes); wick share = mean over bars t-11..t of (h - l - |c - o|) / (h - l) (bars with h = l skipped); range-to-spread = median(h - l) / median(ask_c - bid_c) over bars t-11..t
H1.buckets: quintiles per instrument x timeframe x measure; edges from dev-window bars only (np.quantile 0.2/0.4/0.6/0.8); bucket = searchsorted(edges, x, right); the same edges apply to 2023+
H1.atr: production supertrend ATR (flips.mjs, Wilder ATR(10)) at bar t; the request said ATR14 and named the production ATR; the production ATR is used
H1.outcome: move = mid open of bar t+1+N minus mid open of bar t+1, N in [3, 6, 12], bars t+1..t+1+N contiguous; a = |move| / ATR_t; clear move iff a >= 0.5; no direction iff a < 0.25; continuation iff sign(move) = sign(c_t - c_(t-12)) (both non-zero); signed continuation = sign(c_t - c_(t-12)) x move / ATR_t
H1.primary: WTICO/USD M5 N=6, three separate tests: P(clear) in the chop quintile minus P(clear) in the clean quintile; chop/clean = ER lowest/highest, wick share highest/lowest, range-to-spread lowest/highest. Predicted < 0. A measure PASSES iff the 95% day-block CI upper bound < 0 in BOTH dev and 2023+. Each measure has its own verdict; no pooling across measures.
H1.secondary: P(no direction) chop minus clean (predicted > 0), mean |move|/ATR, continuation rate and mean signed continuation per quintile (does chop predict a reversal (P(cont) < 0.5, signed < 0) or only a lack of continuation); all instruments, M1, M15, N=3 and 12 descriptive.

H2.session: trading day = validate.day_of (22:00 UTC rollover), Mon-Fri keys; day open = mid open of its first bar; session end = mid close of its last bar in the data
H2.daily_atr: DATR = mean of (max mid high - min mid low) over the previous 14 trading days that have >= 50% of their M5 bars (strictly earlier days; no event without 14 such days)
H2.leg: causal, fixed: up-leg_t = c_t - min(mid low over the last 48 bars of the same trading day, bars max(day start, t-47)..t); down-leg_t = max(mid high over the same bars) - c_t
H2.events: for each L in [0.3, 0.6, 1.0] and each direction separately: the first closed bar per trading day with leg >= L x DATR, provided the next bar is in the same trading day. Leg size S = leg at that bar. Rough WTI scale: DATR ~ 2.5-3% of price, so L = 0.3/0.6/1.0 is about 0.75%/1.5%/2.5%.
H2.outcomes: from P0 = mid open of the next bar, on mid closes to the session end, rel = leg direction x (close - P0): race = 1 iff rel <= -0.5 S comes before rel >= +0.5 S (unresolved by session end -> excluded from the race); counter = 1 iff the drawdown from the running extreme in the leg direction (starting at P0) reaches S before session end; sess = rel at the last close / DATR; h12/h48 = signed move to the mid open of bar entry + 12/48 (contiguous) / DATR; fade_net (secondary) = opposite-side trade at bid/ask from the next bar open to the session-end close / DATR
H2.null: per event, 200 driftless paths of the same length from the event day's M5 mid-close increments (demeaned, resampled with replacement): null P(race) among resolved paths and null P(counter); signed-move null = 0. race_d = race - null race (resolved events), counter_d = counter - null counter
H2.primary: WTICO/USD M5 L=0.6: (a) mean race_d 95% day-block CI lower bound > 0 in BOTH windows; (b) mean sess 95% CI upper bound < 0 in BOTH windows. H2 PASS iff (a) and (b).
H2.hindsight: separately labelled: the same statistics restricted to days with |day close / day open - 1| <= 0.003 (selects on the day end; descriptive only, never a test)

bootstrap: moving-block day bootstrap (validate.day_boot, block 5, 1000 reps, seed 27) over all trading days of the window

budget.primary_tests: H1: 3 (one per measure); H2: 2 (a, b) combined into one verdict
